title: Zesty Buttery Venezuelan Butter Beans Paella
description: A rich and savory Venezuelan dish featuring butter beans and lardons, cooked to perfection in a paella pan. This low-carb friendly recipe is perfect for a midnight craving.
instructions: Heat the paella pan over medium heat and add the lardons to render the fat.
Remove the lardons from the pan and set aside, leaving the rendered fat behind.
Add the chopped onion to the pan and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the soaked and drained butter beans to the pan, stirring to coat with the spice mixture.
Add the chicken broth to the pan and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the unsalted butter until melted and well combined.
Add the cooked lardons back into the pan and stir to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed, then garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
